about: Where the concepts' faces were read (#463, the 3D review's second round). Pixels of the 1254×1254 pictures. Front points were read by eye from 3× enlargements; the side profile is read by face-ratios.py from the picture's own silhouette (luminance over 90, the edge to a fraction of a pixel, smoothed over 3 rows). Vipasyin has no side concept: its side ratios use Śākyamuni's (refs/t05-concept-2026-11-20/05-shakyamuni-right.webp), the same family drawn at the same scale (front and side heights of nose to chin agree, about 60 px).
